title: The Grunion Run, iv
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Fourth year. Gully doesn't come. Wood and the dog go anyway. The strip draws Gully's bucket, empty.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. WOOD and BARNABY. Beside them on the sand, a bucket, empty — Gully's, brought by Wood.

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns and silver fish at the surf line, a young man with a drawing pad, a small dog in the water, and an empty bucket set on the sand beside him, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The bucket. GULLIVER in marker on the side.

image.prompt: close-up of an empty plastic bucket on sand with a name written on it in marker, lantern light

panels.composition: Wood filling the bucket himself. Badly. Fish everywhere. The dog helping, which is not helping.

balloons.text: How does he do this. They're — they're all leaving.

image.prompt: a young man clumsily trying to grab small silver fish into a bucket at night while a small dog makes it worse, lanterns

panels.composition: Silent. Wood on the sand, wet to the knees, the bucket a quarter full. The dog asleep against it. The lanterns. He'll leave the bucket on Gully's porch. The strip doesn't show that.

image.prompt: a young man sitting wet on a night beach beside a bucket a quarter full of small fish, a dog asleep against it, lanterns behind, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Gully absent, the month after the uncle. The strip fills his bucket.
